name: Phalangeal Fracture of the Toe
definition: Fracture of a toe phalanx, commonly after stubbing or crush injury, with importance of alignment, joint involvement and skin integrity.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are used when deformity, first-toe injury or significant trauma is present.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Buddy taping/protective footwear for suitable stable fractures
amber: Great-toe, open, displaced or intra-articular fractures need specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli bhagna phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of a toe phalanx, commonly after stubbing or crush injury, with importance of alignment, joint involvement and skin integrity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
